summary: Append two published Persian Gulf Water core-thickness descriptions while preserving all 713 prior references and their source classes. The new view contains 715 references; model route-depth coverage is unchanged.

scientific_review: The source reports thickness on the order of30-40m for the upstream core down toR18 and approximately100m atR17 after descent. Preserve the first as an approximate regional span with no midpoint and the second as an approximate value with no inferred error bounds. No cast mean/count or sampled min/max is supplied for these narrative descriptions. Source approximate tripling is descriptive, not an exact ratio imposed numerically.

The boundary is the isohaline(S_max+S_env)/2. Keep the hydrographic PGW core distinct from a velocity envelope, salinity-maximum core depth, water depth and upper/lower boundary coordinates. The same boundary convention describes source width and thickness, but exact paired geographic edges, cross-sectional shape and compatible along-current geometry are unresolved. No stored-volume multiplication or route interpolation.

Original institutional author-version prose and Figure5 were textually and visually reviewed. The exact private PDF hash/size matches acquisition metadata. Retain DOI, version-specific locator, source-fact pointers and SHA256. Figure5 was not digitized; no additional curve values or exact common occupation dates were inferred. The source regional distance coordinate is not a geodesic whole-current length.

New v2 loader composes the frozen v1 statistical-thickness validator with a separate approximate-regional-description validator. No unknown cast count is forced into the REDSOX mean-statistic class. Source class, boundary equation, regional role, approximate qualifier, unknown uncertainty/dates and all physical/annual/volume flags remain explicit. The inherited member index is labeled as covering the frozen base only.

Twenty-six cloud checks passed: thirteen frozen REDSOX checks and thirteen new regional/inventory checks. They preserve all713prior references, old immutable pieces, current records, source contexts, REDSOX thresholds and combinedCSVcells/order. Six exact-code baseline checks also passed.
